email.staffInvite.subject: Your HandyHub staff account
email.staffInvite.body:
You have been invited to the HandyHub staff app.

Set your password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.
email.staffReset.subject: Reset your HandyHub staff password
email.staffReset.body:
Someone asked to reset the password of your HandyHub staff account.

Choose a new password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours:
{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
signIn.heading: Staff sign-in
forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your staff account. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once.
setPassword.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
setPassword.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with your new password.
setPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask the owner for a new invite, or request a new reset link.
error.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
error.NOT_CONFIGURED: This is not set up yet. Ask the owner.
mfa.heading: Enter your authenticator code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for HandyHub.
security.heading: Sign-in security
security.recommended: An authenticator app is recommended for your account. It keeps your account safe even if your password is guessed.
security.enrolled: Your authenticator app is set up.
security.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up.
security.secretIntro: Add this key to your authenticator app (for example by choosing "Enter a setup key"), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.recoveryIntro: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.reauthIntro: Enter your password again to continue.
